title: Art on the Water: Why FYI Yachts is a Must-Visit During the Coconut Grove Arts Festival
description: Experience Art on the Water at the Coconut Grove Arts Festival—visit FYI Yachts in Miami over Presidents’ Day weekend for luxury yachts, waterfront views and cruises.
html:
FYI Yachts at Coconut Grove Arts Festival 2026: Art on Miami’s Waterfront

This Presidents’ Day weekend, Miami’s iconic Coconut Grove comes alive with one of the nation’s most celebrated cultural events: the 62nd Annual Coconut Grove Arts Festival, taking place February 14–16, 2026.

For over six decades, the Coconut Grove Arts Festival has transformed the streets and waterfront into a vibrant showcase of creativity — drawing tens of thousands of art lovers, families, and visitors from across the country. With hundreds of artists exhibiting everything from glass and clay to digital and fiber art, the festival offers a bayfront alfresco setting where art, community, and culture meet.

Where Art Meets the Waterfront Lifestyle

Coconut Grove’s unique blend of artistic energy and seaside beauty makes it the perfect backdrop for an event that celebrates creativity in all its forms. And when you’re exploring creative masterpieces on land, why not take that inspiration to the water?

That’s where FYI Yachts comes in.

As Miami’s premier luxury yacht brokerage, FYI Yachts brings the same appreciation for design, craftsmanship, and unforgettable experiences to life on the water that the Arts Festival celebrates on land. Whether you’re a seasoned mariner, an art enthusiast visiting Miami for the festival, or someone looking to elevate your weekend with something truly memorable, FYI offers the ultimate extension of the festival experience — “Art on the Water.”

2012 Azimut Grande 105

Explore the Ultimate Waterfront Lifestyle

Here’s why stopping by FYI Yachts during the Coconut Grove Arts Festival makes perfect sense:

  • Unmatched Luxury Meets Creative Expression Just as the festival spotlights the finest in visual arts, FYI Yachts showcases the finest in yacht design — from sleek motor yachts to elegant cruisers — where artistry meets engineering. With expert consultants ready to guide visitors through the latest models and bespoke offerings, it’s an immersive experience for anyone who appreciates form, function, and beauty.
  • Prime Location in the Heart of Miami’s Waterfront FYI Yachts’ Coconut Grove presence places you steps from festival excitement and waterfront views alike, making it a seamless stop as part of your festival itinerary.
  • Experience Miami From a New Perspective After you’ve wandered through festival stands and enjoyed local culinary vendors, imagine a sunset cruise on Biscayne Bay — artful reflections dancing off the water, Miami’s skyline glowing in the distance. FYI can help make that dream come true with tailored yacht charters and private experiences curated to your tastes.

Connect with Creativity and Community

The Coconut Grove Arts Festival isn’t just about viewing incredible artwork — it’s about connection. With live music, interactive exhibits, workshops, and a community spirit that’s palpable throughout the weekend, the festival is one of South Florida’s signature cultural gatherings.

Likewise, FYI Yachts prides itself on building community and fostering connections — whether it’s between a client and their perfect vessel or between like-minded enthusiasts who share a love for the water and lifestyle. And just like the festival’s commitment to arts education and emerging talent, FYI supports creative experiences that bring people together (as seen in recent events like their collaboration with Billboard Latin Week).

Make the Most of Your Weekend

Whether you’re drawn by the fine works of art showcased at the Coconut Grove Arts Festival or the allure of life on the water, make this weekend one to remember. Stop by FYI Yachts during the festivities to explore luxurious yachts, connect with marine lifestyle experts, and see firsthand why the intersection of art and yachting is an experience like no other.

Festival Dates:

🗓 February 14–16, 2026

📍 Coconut Grove, FL Waterfront Streets & Bayshore Drive
